title: PC running slowly
symptom: PC has become very slow over the last few days
user_description: My computer is crawling today. Everything takes ages to open and I've got a report due. It was fine last week.

options.why: Far too drastic for a slow PC. It wastes hours and erases settings when a simple cause is far more likely.

options.text: Ask when it started, check what is using the CPU and memory in Task Manager, and restart the PC if it has not been restarted for a long time
options.why: Slowness often comes from one busy program or a PC that has run for days without a restart. Finding out when it started and what is busy points to the real cause.
Costly and premature. Nobody has yet checked whether memory is actually the problem.

options.text: Delete files from the Windows folder to free space
options.why: Dangerous. Deleting system files can stop Windows from starting. Never delete things you do not understand.

hints: What questions would help you find out what changed?
Which built-in tool shows what is using the processor and memory?
real_world_tip: Ask 'When did you last restart?' A surprising number of slow PCs have not been restarted in weeks.
